app.name: Axis Davis Capacity Planner
app.description: Axis infrastructure capacity planning, forecasting and AI-assisted incident RCA.

scopes.name: storage:metrics:read
scopes.comment: Read host and service metrics from Grail

scopes.name: storage:buckets:read
scopes.comment: Read Grail data required by the capacity agent

scopes.name: storage:entities:read
scopes.comment: Read host entities and management zone membership

scopes.name: storage:spans:read
scopes.comment: Read request-root spans for application-service throughput analysis

scopes.name: storage:events:read
scopes.comment: Read Davis problems and event records for interactive capacity questions and RCA

scopes.name: storage:logs:read
scopes.comment: Read incident-window logs for RCA evidence

scopes.name: davis:analyzers:execute
scopes.comment: Execute Dynatrace Intelligence problem analysis and forecast analyzers

scopes.name: davis-copilot:conversations:execute
scopes.comment: Generate AI-assisted capacity responses and incident RCA using Dynatrace Assist

scopes.name: davis-copilot:document-search:execute
scopes.comment: Allow RCA investigations to use Dynatrace document context when enabled

scopes.name: davis-copilot:nl2dql:execute
scopes.comment: Generate read-only DQL from natural-language capacity questions

scopes.name: document:documents:read
scopes.comment: Read conversation documents for future session continuity

scopes.name: document:documents:write
scopes.comment: Persist agentic conversation documents when enabled
